mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, COM_NAME, COM_INFO, COM_NUM, COM_EMAIL, COM_URL, COM_CREATE_YEAR, COM_MEM, COM_LOGO, COM_PAYMENT, INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM COMPANY

SELECT
cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_ONE_LINE, crq.REVIEW_SUBJECT_CODE, crq.COMPANY_REVIEW_SCORE, cc.CODE_NAME
FROM COMPANY_REVIEW cr LEFT JOIN COMPANY_REVIEW_QUESTION crq ON cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = crq.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN CMN_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_DETAIL_NO = crq.REVIEW_SUBJECT_CODE AND cc.CODE_GROUP_NO = 'REVU' WHERE cr.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.COMPANY_REVIEW_NO, cc.SORT_ORDER
